request.prompt: Correct the EFFECT TIMING in the supplied claw attack video. Keep exactly the same forest wendigo, bark/leaf materials, ivory skull and horns, static overhead camera, earth clearing and ONE claw sweep. This is a synchronized contact-effects revision, not a different attack. The original video has an ERROR: the dirt and debris burst happens AFTER the white slash has already finished. Remove that delayed burst completely. Instead show one simultaneous event: as soon as the claw hand begins its fast low sweep and the first white claw streak appears, that SAME moving contact point rips open the earth and ejects soil, bark chips and low dust. The bright slash and the earth spray must coexist clearly in the SAME frames during the full fast sweep. Three short ivory claw traces, fresh three grooves and directional dark soil spray travel together with the physical claw tips. By the time the slash fades the dirt chunks are ALREADY airborne, and after the hand finishes its sweep there are ONLY falling chunks, settling low dust and recovery, absolutely no new eruption or flash. Choreography: anticipation first 0.8 second; around 1.0 second start the fast strike AND ground eruption simultaneously; finish all new particle emission within the next 0.25 second; remaining time is natural ballistic settling. The burst is a short dense low fan of earth and wood driven in the strike direction, no huge explosion, no fire, no persistent glow. Preserve full-body framing, one continuous shot, no new limbs, no cuts, no camera motion, no text, no sound.
